mathematical_result: For every full inclusion D into C of fusion categories over C, with D carrying the restricted spherical pivotal structure, M = _D C_C with t = categorical spherical trace is a normalized nondegenerate traced bimodule. CM published Proposition5.17/Theorems5.18/6.4 and Example6.5 give an oriented inclusion-dependent interface between bulk theories monoidally naturally isomorphic to TVBW(D) and TVBW(C).
important_caveats: Both partial traces are verified, with sphericity identifying left and right categorical traces.
Inherited/pivotal compatibility is essential, as shown by the Vec_Z2 counterexample.
CM categorical arrow D -> C is distinguished from geometric positive-normal conventions.
Actual orientation-reversal duality maps are CM Euler-completed adjunction maps; no equality with Meusburger full-defect model asserted.
Bulk identification uses CRS3 Theorem4.5 diagonal boundary conjugation Eq4.70 and cylinder-projector images.
Source reconstruction and alpha-induction input coverage are separate shared-PASS1 obligations.
